p-ironandresin-14939738177904.d:
The Basin Jacket is back, and this time it came home with a new yoke. Everything you remember about the original is still here: the waxed cotton canvas exterior, the sherpa collar, the eco-friendly poly fill that keeps the cold out without weighing you down. But we swapped the drum dyed leather for a goat suede yoke this time around, softer to the touch, just as tough where it counts, and honestly, it might be the detail that makes this one even better than the first.
Everything else that made the Basin Jacket a cold weather go-to is still built in. A talon zipper and snap front placket make it easy to get in and out of. A snap-button neck adds warmth when the mornings get bone-chilling. And with two exterior snap pockets plus a trio of interior pockets, including a dedicated spot for your phone, this jacket still carries what you need without you having to think about it.
You know this jacket. You just haven't met this version of it yet.
SPECS + DETAILS
• Exterior:4.5oz Waxed Cotton Canvas
• Interior: 3oz Eco-Friendly Polyester Filling
• Talon Front Zipper Closure + Front Placket With Brushed Silver Heavy Metal Buttons
• Shearling Collar Lining
• Goat Suede Yoke
